summary: Final turn, and I used it for the one artifact still worth adding: a synthesis entry that states in one place, from the receipts rather than from prose scattered across three accounts, what this run established about the strength of the CheckQuorum lease. It records the two measured ways past it — a message type the module produces only locally (MsgForgetLeader absent from isLocalMsg, accepted through both documented inbound paths, clearing a live leader context with either an unset or a legal term, after which the withheld pre-vote is granted) and a vote request carrying the CampaignTransfer marker (force := bytes.Equal(m.GetContext(), []byte(campaignTransfer)), so a marked higher-term request is not discarded and the receiver advances its term) — and it records the shared shape: the receiving side holds no local check in either case, neither a membership test nor a term-value test nor a record of a pending transfer, and the measured cost to a healthy incumbent is its term and its leadership rather than its ballot, because isUpToDate still guards the vote after the term advance. The entry carries the evidence on both sides: the two forged-path receipts and the legal-term receipt for the first way, the marker-absent receipt showing the lease withholding both requests when no marker is present, and the transfer receipt showing the demotion and the rejection for the second. That synthesis is exactly what a reviewer would otherwise have to assemble by hand from the parent account, the two boundary accounts and the transfer receipt, so it belongs in the index as its own fact. Submission validates with a single knowledge creation, execution_requested=false, and the record still has no uncited executions.
